review.identity: All six poses preserve the adopted neutral face, proportions, species markings and fur/spine texture; no duplicated/extra limb or changed species was found.
review.style: Warm-brown contour and watercolor-paper texture remain natural beside the selected neutral at430px standing body scale. Minor generated pose differences are acceptable; no heavy sticker contour outlier.
review.alpha: True RGBA, transparent background and separated cells; no visible clipping, checkerboard or colored matte on proper cream/dark alpha composites. The source maximum alpha254 is retained unchanged.
review.motion: Six distinct reusable poses, grounded foot-center annotations and a single standing-scale reference across every cell. Lookout: one paw shades the forehead, the other hangs down; both feet stay planted.

poses.measured_contact: Midpoint of the two actual hind-foot/paw contact centers, excluding the tail; baseline is the lower visible planted foot boundary.

geometry_review.measurement_method: Exact512x512 cells in the1536x1024 original sheet. Alpha>=8 visible bounds plus anatomical foot contact review. Body rectangles exclude long sideways tails where separable; no per-frame bbox fit is used.
geometry_review.standing_reference_method: One common height measured from the ordinary standing cells, used for all six poses. Grounded shorter crouch/tuck poses retain their intentional height difference.
limitations: These are six reviewed reusable static pose keys, not proof of an arbitrary future video transition or interpolated animation.
Anatomical body rectangles and foot-center anchors are manually reviewed source-cell coordinates; the per-character standing reference scale is fixed across every pose.
